clause_verbatim: third-party re-upload; official distribution requires an agreement form; no official checksum exists; contents unverifiable against the canonical release.
scope: Entries under data/exploratory/** are exploratory-class. They are NOT Tier 2 and NOT registered inputs. Nothing derived from them may enter a registered artifact, a paper claim, or be pooled with any registered result. This manifest exists so that their presence cannot hard-block a registered launch: exploration must never gate the registered track.
not_a_seal: This is not a seal. A seal attests that bytes came from a known source; this attests only that the bytes have not changed since they were recorded, which is the strongest claim available for material whose origin is unknown.
